summary: SeleneTrace is an automated geospatial intelligence engine designed to bridge the gap between planetary exploration and terrestrial testing. Instead of relying on traditional, over-visited analog sites, our platform features a reverse-search similarity engine. By ingesting multi-dimensional raster data—including topography, slope distribution, diurnal temperature extremes, rock abundance, and mineral spectral indices-mission planners can select any coordinate on the Moon or Mars (such as Shackleton Crater or Jezero Crater) to automatically discover, rank, and score optimized, under-explored Earth analogs complete with a transparent fidelity gap readout.
details:
Github Repo - https://github.com/AgrimJain12/SeleneTrace

  • What it does & How it works:
    GroundControl1 is an automated geospatial intelligence platform designed to bridge the gap between planetary exploration and terrestrial testing. Instead of manually relying on a small set of over-visited analog sites, our system features a reverse-search similarity engine. By ingesting multi-dimensional raster data—such as topography, slope distribution, diurnal temperature extremes, rock abundance, and mineral spectral indices—mission planners can click any coordinate on the Moon or Mars (including Shackleton Crater, Mare Tranquillitatis, Marius Hills, and Jezero Crater) and automatically discover, rank, and score the top under-explored Earth analogs.
    • Planetary Targets: Ingested via NASA Moon Trek and NASA Mars Trek (trek.nasa.gov/moon, trek.nasa.gov/mars), alongside high-resolution Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) and mineralogy layers.
      image.png
    • Earth Candidates & Processing: Processed using Google Earth Engine (utilizing Copernicus DEM GLO30, SRTM, MODIS Land Surface Temperature, and ASTER datasets), paired with Python (rasterio, numpy, pandas) for geospatial window slicing, feature normalization, and vector distance scoring.
    • GIS Workflows: Leveraged JMARS for advanced planetary layer verification.
  • Key Innovation & Fidelity Gaps:
    Unlike generic map viewers, GroundControl1 deconstructs similarity across independent engineering axes (geomorphology/mobility, thermal cycling, and mineralogy/ISRU). Crucially, it includes an explicit Fidelity Gap readout that highlights environmental divergences—such as Earth's atmospheric pressure and moisture differentials—providing transparency for rover hardware and instrument testing. Negative control checks (like the Amazon rainforest and agricultural land) are embedded into the scoring harness to ensure rigorous model validation.
